title: DebateSim: CoT Drift in Multi-Agent Debate Systems in an Architectural and Empirical Study

contributions.purpose: 把立法辩论建成多轮过程而非单轮摘要
contributions.mechanism: 角色专门化多智能体(Pro/Con辩手+AI裁判+记忆管理),每轮注入完整transcript,五轮制
contributions.evaluation: 开场结构合规 100%(恰好3个标注论点)
contributions.domain: 多智能体辩论 / 立法分析
contributions.source_quote: A role-specialized, multi-agent architecture for process-level legislative debate with explicit transcript conditioning each round.

contributions.purpose: 跨轮保持事实/引用/承诺一致
contributions.mechanism: 上下文持久化层,蒸馏关键事实注入后续轮次
contributions.source_quote: A context-persistence framework that preserves salient facts, citations, and commitments, enabling cross-round coherence.

contributions.purpose: 提供可审计的辩论质量评测套件
contributions.mechanism: 系统指标(延迟/内存)+ 辩论质量指标(引用有效性/反驳率/覆盖/裁判一致)+ drift 分析,输出 JSON artifacts
contributions.evaluation: 延迟均值 17.7s/轮,峰值内存 23MB,并发3辩论25轮无回归
contributions.source_quote: An evaluation suite combining system metrics (latency, memory) with debate-quality indicators (citation validity, rebuttal engagement, coverage, judge agreement) and drift analysis.

contributions.purpose: 在真实法案上实证有效性
contributions.mechanism: H.R.40 与 H.R.1 两法案跑50场五轮辩论
contributions.evaluation: 结构合规100%,引用准确率89%,一致性 +23pp
contributions.source_quote: An empirical study on H.R. 40 and H.R. 1 demonstrating 100% structural compliance, 89% citation accuracy, and a +23 pp consistency improvement, with real-time responsiveness.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This approach is inspired by debates for factual arbitration [8, 13] and multi-agent collaboration for complex tasks [9, 14], while adapting them to the legal/legislative domain where citation grounding and provenance are crucial [1, 2].

DebateSim differs from single-agent summarization [1], generic multi-agent role-play [9, 14], and prior debate work [8] by (i) requiring statutory citations, (ii) enforcing a five-round, rebuttal-heavy format with explicit structure, and (iii) reporting interpretable process metrics and drift.

notes: desk-reject。有4条自声明贡献,四元组适配良好但质量红旗多:(1)标题-内容不符:题为"CoT Drift"但正文对 drift 几乎无实质分析,仅3.6/3.5节一笔带过;(2)数据雷同红旗:Table 1 中 H.R.40 与 H.R.1 两栏几乎全同(引用准确率89/89、一致性+23/+23、内存delta -0.14/-0.14、峰值内存23/23、最快最慢8.81/59.92完全相同),两不同法案指标高度一致极可疑;(3)样本量自相矛盾:摘要与结论称"25 total rounds",结果节又称"50 complete five-round debates"(应=250轮),Table 1 标"50 debates"却又给"3 debates,25 rounds";(4)裁判全为AI、无人工评估,89%引用准确率与+23pp均由自家脚本产出,循环自证;(5)参考文献[5][6][7][12]作者名泛化、URL可疑(如 collaborative-synthesis.pdf),疑似编造。trade-off:第7节自认速度-质量权衡、纯AI评估局限。checklist全 Yes(理论项 NA)。
